critical_code_review_comments: routes/architecture.py:289-298 start_recommend — calls require_stage_context BEFORE _new_job, so the 400 fires synchronously and the job registry stays clean. Good.

routes/architecture.py:441-449 start_hld / 523-531 start_lld / 596-604 start_seq — DO NOT call require_stage_context synchronously; the gate runs inside the background job. This means /jobs/start/hld returns 202-style {job_id} even for projects where DataModel is not frozen, and the error only surfaces via polling. Inconsistent with start_recommend. Recommend hoisting the gate check to the route handler to fail fast and match recommend's behaviour.
routes/codegen.py:323-333 start_codegen — correctly gates synchronously with require_stage_context BEFORE spawning the task. Good.

routes/codegen.py:445 — `r.get('commit').sha if isinstance(r, dict) else getattr(r.get('commit'), 'sha', '') if r else ''` — PyGithub returns objects, not dicts; the isinstance(dict) branch is dead code and the second `r.get('commit')` will AttributeError on the non-dict path. Fix: `getattr(r['commit'], 'sha', '')` or `r['commit'].sha`.
routes/codegen.py:294-296 services_done counter — increments on next-service transition, so when only _root files remain at end, the last real service is undercounted. Cosmetic.

routes/architecture.py:96-117 _save_arch_doc — fine; uses upsert on (project_id, type). Note: api_contracts is created via second _save_arch_doc inside _run_lld_job at line 511 without a tracability for datamodel; minor traceability gap.

routes/codegen.py:236-321 _run_codegen_job — when only_service is set, the job spawns root_files extension is skipped — good — but `services_total` is computed off the filtered services list, so the run doc's totals are correct.

Pipeline gate consistency: arch jobs (hld/lld/seq) burn an in-memory job slot and only fail asynchronously when DataModel isn't frozen. Add `await require_stage_context(...)` at the top of each start_* route for symmetry.
